description.message: Warns you when a photo you are about to upload carries your location or other hidden data, and cleans it on request. Fully local.

p_title.message: This photo says where it was taken.

p_body_one.message: Hidden data in {1}. Whoever receives it can read it:

p_body_many.message: Hidden data in {1} photos. Whoever receives them can read it:

p_note1.message: Cleaning does not change the picture. Klin checks photos you pick or drop on the page. Not pasted ones.

p_note2.message: It cannot know what a site does with a photo you keep.

p_failed.message: Klin could not check this photo, so it was sent as it is.
